body:
Reported Player(s): LOOTER4
Rules Broken: It was sort of hard to tell and I spent about 20 minutes just spectating him to try be sure he is hacking. In the first video it is when I tried to fight him where you can see he killed me upon instant contact almost using an iron sword which seems very odd. The second is just him from spec point of view but he does not look to dodgy yet the up close one kind of gives it away I think. Whatever you guys think, personally I think he is autoclicking. I know other players also thought so.
Evidence:  
Vid 1:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4EV-azI0qU4&feature=youtu.be
Vid 2:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3QGF0H2-TlY&feature=youtu.be

I have one more video that might be of help if needed.
